source_policy: A8 byte-copies the complete current A1 PR #20 original SOH 16px terrain and prop atlases (1,759 terrain frames and 138 props) and composes only existing Quarry and Orchard scenes. A8 also carries a five-frame local surface strip and one source-backed warm radial light crop. No A0/A1/A3 source is edited; no third-party candidate art or avatar art is mixed into these scenes.

surface_derivative_source.policy: A8-local 80x16 exact RGBA crop strip from the complete current A1 terrain atlas for the authored Orchard bank/bridge surface compositor.

transform_policy: 16px terrain cells; source-sized props anchored bottom-center at integer local pixels; nearest filtering; no fractional scale; shell doorway remains visually and physically clear.

overcast_frontier.notes: neutral grey-violet daylight; warm shelter pockets at night

amber_morning.notes: living green/amber canopy; warm worked windows

frost_blue_hour.notes: cold snow/basalt; soul-cyan shrine accent and rare warm refuge

visual_contract_summary.perspective: top-down three-quarter; props feet-anchored at bottom-center on integer pixels
visual_contract_summary.collision_readability: art creates no collision; physical mass uses authored A8 collision geometry
visual_contract_summary.lighting: A1 ambient profiles overcast_frontier and amber_morning are applied as shared day ambient tints; lamp is source art only, no A0 clock/Light2D integration is claimed
visual_contract_summary.adoption: Adopt complete 16px current A1 terrain/prop atlases, authored transition masks, grounded source-sized props, semantic paths, and state-projected local lighting. Preserve A1 scene and physical contracts.
visual_contract_summary.rejected_inherited_art: Alternate source packs were reviewed by exact file/frame and pixel scale; only pixels compatible with the A1 palette, top-down/3-quarter view, and 16px grammar are eligible. Quarry/Orchard use current A1 environment art as the coherent base. See docs/survival/world_content/A8_R13_ASSET_REVIEW_20261031.md for reviewed candidates, source identities, and visual exclusions.

a1_shell_visual_source.adoption: Use current A1 shell skin and full current atlas pixels; preserve the 128x128 shells, doorways, local roots, canonical cells and source-sized prop frames.

a8_visual_overrides.reason: The source anchor intersects the physical entry radius; the alternative left-side placement collided visually with the authored rock. Keep the native doorway approach clean.
Move the rack outside A1 doorway_clear_rect_px without changing any collision.
The source handcart overlaps the A1 doorway-clear rectangle/portal; keep the wheel, log pile, fences and mill-house landmark.
Use the native 56px frame wholly inside the 128px shell instead of clipping four pixels.
The 76px-tall landmark otherwise clips 12px beyond the shell; keep the full source frame visible above the doorway-clear zone.

a1_shell_visual_source.rejected_inherited_art: A8 now byte-copies the complete current A1 PR #20 terrain and prop atlases at head e1e4e9a4. It uses compatible source frames for Quarry/Orchard; the five-frame Orchard surface strip and Quarry local light have separate exact-crop provenance. The old 939720d5 atlas pin and 23 moved-frame compatibility workaround are superseded. Other reviewed packs remain excluded on pixel palette/view/scene semantics, not licensing; see A8_R13_ASSET_REVIEW_20261031.md.

current_a1_compatibility.summary: A8 now byte-copies A1 current terrain.png (1,759 frames) and props.png (138 frames) at exact current atlas coordinates, plus an A1 archive radial light texture. Site compositions are audited against the frame manifest; rejected alternate packs are documented with source-file identities and frame evidence.
